assessment.freshTarget: Existing destination, dangling symlink and cooperative crash lock reject. Source/target containment and canonical-parent checks reject aliases. Private caller-owned parent is required.
assessment.tamper: Pinned manifest digest and independent exact inventory contract, source commit/frontend pins, exact file lists, byte hashes and size assertions reject checked tampering. Source verified again after copy. SQLite sealed delete mode and integrity checked; Redis data encoding checked but not executed.
assessment.partialCleanup: Injected write failure independently rerun: stage and owned lock removed, final target absent, source retained. This is not power-loss recovery proof.
assessment.authority: Materialization receipt explicitly denies boot/execution authority and Redis activation. No runtime or admission calls present.

limitations: Same-UID hostile mutation is explicitly excluded in author notes. Absence check plus rename is not an atomic no-replace guarantee against uncooperative writers; destructive cleanup assumes the private parent and cooperative lock remain controlled. Do not use as writer-exclusion evidence.
Manifest producer and complete topology inventory, consistent capture, source quarantine, Redis activation and session TTL restoration remain outside this patch.
No process-crash/power-loss atomic recovery or operational boot demonstrated.
No full #33/#39 or owner amendment acceptance established.
